meta.author_theory: Maybe I was just super imaginative.

locations.location_name: inside of a tower / science lab ("dream makers" room)

qualities.raw_description: "strange place"; "like the inside of a tower/science lab"; pipes and tubes around the room; stone altar/counter covered with beakers and papers; (image) circular stone/brick chamber with many green pipes; central stone table with open book and flasks; arched opening with orange firelight; cauldron/pot

interactions.description: Dreamer tries to change the dream or wake up but it "wouldn't work"; dreamer panics and hides behind a pipe; toad-like robed creature senses the dreamer and calls them out; two creatures question how the dreamer got there; toad-like creature threatens that if the dreamer tells anyone, "something very bad will happen to your family"; dreamer asks them not to hurt family and asks to watch them make dreams but is ignored; toad-like creature says he will be around the dreamer's entire life but dreamer will never see him or visit that place again; creature says something the dreamer didn't understand and sends them back; dreamer wakes up.

entities_involved.description: Yellowish; toad-shaped head, human-like body; wore a robe; sensed dreamer behind a pipe; spoke for both as "dream makers"
Shorter; ant-shaped head; wore a robe; standing and talking with the other creature at the stone altar/counter

extraction.extraction_notes: Image appears to be an AI-style illustration (not a hand-drawn map). Spatial extraction is primarily single-room layout: circular chamber with extensive piping converging at a central worktable/altar; arched fire-lit opening and a cauldron-like pot visible.
